modern: A scowling look is entirely unnatural; when it is often put on, the result is that all good looks die away, and at last are so completely extinguished that they cannot be lit up again at all. Try to conclude from this very fact that it is contrary to reason. For if even the awareness of doing wrong is lost, what reason is there for living any longer?
original: A scowling look is altogether unnatural; when it is often assumed, the result is that all comeliness dies away, and at last is so completely extinguished that it cannot be again lighted up at all. Try to conclude from this very fact that it is contrary to reason. For if even the perception of doing wrong shall depart, what reason is there for living any longer?
